title: Uppercase Converter
description: Convert any text into fully capitalized uppercase letters instantly.
introText: This tool converts your text into all uppercase letters in one click. It's useful for headlines, emphasis, or formatting requirements.

title: Lowercase Converter
description: Convert any text into fully lowercase letters instantly.
introText: This tool converts your text into all lowercase letters in one click. It's handy for normalizing text before processing or comparison.

title: Sentence Case Converter
description: Convert text into proper sentence case, capitalizing the first letter of each sentence.
introText: This tool automatically capitalizes the first letter of every sentence in your text. It helps clean up text pasted from sources with inconsistent capitalization.

title: Title Case Converter
description: Convert text into title case by capitalizing the first letter of each major word.
introText: This tool capitalizes the first letter of each significant word, following standard title casing rules. It's ideal for headlines, titles, and article names.

title: Slug Generator
description: Convert text into a clean, URL-friendly slug with hyphens and lowercase letters.
introText: This tool transforms your text into a URL-safe slug by removing special characters and replacing spaces with hyphens. It's perfect for creating SEO-friendly URLs.

title: camelCase Converter
description: Convert text into camelCase format commonly used in programming variable names.
introText: This tool reformats your text into camelCase, joining words and capitalizing each word except the first. It's widely used for naming variables and functions in code.

title: snake_case Converter
description: Convert text into snake_case format using underscores between lowercase words.
introText: This tool converts your text into snake_case by joining words with underscores. It's commonly used for variable names in Python and database column naming.

title: kebab-case Converter
description: Convert text into kebab-case format using hyphens between lowercase words.
introText: This tool converts your text into kebab-case by joining words with hyphens. It's often used in URLs, CSS classes, and file naming conventions.

title: Remove Extra Spaces
description: Remove extra, duplicate, and trailing spaces from your text automatically.
introText: This tool strips out multiple consecutive spaces and trims unnecessary whitespace from your text. It's useful for cleaning up copy-pasted or poorly formatted content.

title: Reverse Text Generator
description: Reverse the order of characters in your text instantly.
introText: This tool flips your entire text backward, reversing the character order. It's fun for creating mirrored text or checking palindromes.

title: Word Counter
description: Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in your text instantly.
introText: This tool analyzes your text and provides accurate counts of words, characters, and sentences. It's essential for writers tracking length requirements.

title: Remove Line Breaks
description: Remove all line breaks and newlines from your text, merging it into one line.
introText: This tool eliminates line breaks and paragraph spacing, joining your text into a continuous block. It's helpful when preparing text for single-line fields or formats.

title: Capitalize First Letter
description: Capitalize only the first letter of your text or each line automatically.
introText: This tool capitalizes the first letter of your text while leaving the rest unchanged. It's a quick fix for text that starts with a lowercase letter.

title: Alternating Case Converter
description: Convert text into alternating uppercase and lowercase letters for a fun mocking style.
introText: This tool alternates the case of each letter in your text, creating a distinctive zigzag pattern. It's popular for sarcastic memes and playful text styling.

title: Base64 Encoder
description: Encode plain text into Base64 format for safe data transmission and storage.
introText: This tool converts your text into Base64-encoded output, a common format for encoding binary and text data. It's useful for developers working with APIs and data URIs.

title: Remove Duplicate Lines
description: Remove repeated, identical lines from your text and keep only unique entries.
introText: This tool scans your text line by line and eliminates any duplicates, keeping only unique lines. It's great for cleaning lists, logs, or datasets.

title: Trim Whitespace
description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from every line of your text.
introText: This tool strips unwanted spaces, tabs, and blank characters from the start and end of your text. It helps standardize formatting before further processing.

title: Remove Numbers
description: Remove all numeric digits from your text, leaving only letters and symbols.
introText: This tool scans your text and deletes every numeric digit it finds. It's useful for cleaning data or isolating non-numeric content.

title: Remove Punctuation
description: Remove all punctuation marks from your text, leaving only words and spaces.
introText: This tool strips commas, periods, exclamation marks, and other punctuation from your text. It's helpful for text analysis, tokenization, or casual cleanup.

title: URL Encoder
description: Encode text into URL-safe format by converting special characters to percent-encoded sequences.
introText: This tool converts your text into a URL-encoded string, replacing unsafe characters with percent-encoded equivalents. It's essential for building valid query strings and links.
